tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the case studies VIVIFY Solutions has published. Returns id, title, tag, one-line summary, and tech stack for each.

stack.description: Optional tech to filter by, e.g. 'n8n', 'Gemini', 'VAPI'.

tools.name: get_project
tools.title: Get project case study
tools.description: Return the full case study (problem, solution, result, stack) for one VIVIFY project by id. Use list_projects first to discover ids.

tools.name: get_services
tools.title: Get services
tools.description: Return the service groups, the individual systems and the packages VIVIFY Solutions offers (pilot and provider-dependent services are labelled), plus the platforms used in its projects.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.title: Get contact info
tools.description: Return the public contact channels for VIVIFY Solutions: email, website, LinkedIn and the free discovery-call booking link.

tools.name: get_about
tools.title: Get about VIVIFY Solutions
tools.description: Return the short bio and brand info for VIVIFY Solutions / Viviene Pitogo, plus any owner-verified statistics (currently none are published).
